children: Mortgage rates this week rose to just under 7% in their greatest one-week gain since April 2025, according to one closely watched weekly average.

Freddie Mac's average 30-year fixed mortgage rate during the week ended Sept. 16 was 6.95%, up from 6.76% one week prior. Other gauges, such as those published by Mortgage News Daily and Bankrate, have surpassed 7%.

The rise in mortgage rates has weighed on real estate stocks. The iShares U.S. Home Construction exchange-traded fund is down 0.9% this week, on track for its sixth straight down week, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
